name: C-8813
summary: C-8813 (thiobromadol) is a potent μ-opioid receptor agonist with a distinctive chemical structure which is not closely related to other established families of opioid drugs. The trans-isomer was found to be around 591 times more potent than morphine in animal studies. The same study assigned a potency of 504 times that of morphine to the related compound BDPC.

pharmacology.text: C-8813 (thiobromadol) is a potent μ-opioid receptor agonist with a distinctive chemical structure which is not closely related to other established families of opioid drugs. C-8813 is claimed to be similarly potent at the δ-opioid receptor, which antagonizes the μ-induced depression of breathing, presumably making the drug safer.

uses.text: C-8813 has never been approved for use in humans.

sideEffects.en: It has never been approved for use in people and has not been studied in them. It is far stronger than morphine, so the margin for error is very small. Strong opioids cause slowed breathing, fatal overdose, drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未獲准用於人體，也未在人體研究過。它的效力遠強於嗎啡，因此容錯空間極小。強效鴉片類會造成呼吸變慢、致命過量、嗜睡、噁心、便祕與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未获准用于人体，也未在人体研究过。它的效力远强于吗啡，因此容错空间极小。强效鸦片类会造成呼吸变慢、致命过量、嗜睡、恶心、便秘与成瘾。

fact.en: Its other name, thiobromadol, says what it is: bromadol with a sulphur atom worked in. Its skeleton is unlike that of any established opioid family, which is unusual for such a potent compound.
fact.zh: 它的另一個名稱 thiobromadol 說明了它的身分：在 bromadol 中加入一個硫原子。它的骨架與任何已確立的鴉片類家族都不同，對如此強效的化合物而言相當罕見。
fact.zhHans: 它的另一个名称 thiobromadol 说明了它的身分：在 bromadol 中加入一个硫原子。它的骨架与任何已确立的鸦片类家族都不同，对如此强效的化合物而言相当罕见。
